# CAUCE 74 · sigma-conditioned H3 latent transport

Four seed/prompt/endpoint-matched samples isolate where a small affine pullback
enters one intact res_multistep call: baseline, early, middle, and late sigma
windows. CAUCE unpacks H3's AV state internally and transports both the current
visual state and retained RES history in the same coordinate frame; audio is
repacked unchanged. No motion-reference video enters any branch. The live-
validated starting strength is 0.10.
